name: Camping 101: Cooking

angles.text: Cooking teaches you to build the campfire needed for a wilderness campsite and its furnishings.
As a priest, you need basic survival skills like building a fire when you travel far from temples and settlements.
As an Alliance adventurer near Dun Morogh, you learn cooking and wilderness skills from the dwarven instructors in Kharanos.

faq.answer: You learn to cook and build campfires, the first steps toward setting up a wilderness camp.
faq.q: What is the quest Camping 101: Cooking?

faq.answer: Gremlock Pilsnor teaches novice adventurers to cook in Kharanos, in Dun Morogh.

aliases: why do i need cooking for camping
faq.answer: Cooking teaches you to build a campfire, the base of a wilderness camp and its furnishings.
faq.q: Why is cooking necessary for camping?

aliases: where can i make a camp
faq.answer: Once you know how to build a fire, you can pitch a basic campsite in the wilderness and rest there on your travels.
faq.q: Where can a campsite be established?

faq.answer: Greater cooking skill lets you build larger campfires, while other crafting trades let you make more campsite furnishings.
faq.q: How do you improve or expand a campsite?

faq.answer: Other crafting trades can add furnishings to your campsite when you have learned the skills to make them.
faq.q: Can other professions contribute to camping?

sections.body: Your first camp in Dun Morogh begins with a fire. In Kharanos, Gremlock Pilsnor teaches novice adventurers to cook. The skill keeps food ready for the road. A sturdy campfire gives an outdoor camp its center.
sections.title: The Hearth in the Wild

sections.body: Once you can build a campfire, you can pitch a humble camp in the open wilderness. A simple fire holds only a few furnishings, but greater cooking skill lets you build larger blazes. Artisans trained in other crafts can make furnishings, turning a basic rest stop into a fully outfitted encampment.
sections.title: Expanding the Campsite

summary: In Dun Morogh, travelers learn to cook and make a fire for the wilds. Gremlock Pilsnor teaches novice adventurers in Kharanos. Cooking keeps food ready for the road and helps travelers light campfires at wilderness campsites.
